source_document.body: Black Friday 2026 is upon us. With the official event date set for Friday, November 27, many of the deals at all the biggest retailers are already live, with savings galore to be found on a raft of PC hardware and technology. Here at our live coverage, you'll find the best deals in every category, curated by our experts who are working around the clock. We're hitting CPUs, GPUs, RAM, SSDs, gaming laptops, desktop PCs, peripherals, monitors, and more. Our buying advice is built on our years of testing experience, as well as extensive price tracking tools, our benchmarking data, and hands-on reviews. With the PC component market facing pressures like never before, finding a good deal and making informed choices is more important than ever, so let us do the legwork and help you get the best deal, whether you're looking to buy, build, or upgrade. Amazon: All Black Friday deals Amazon: 73% off computers and accessories deals Amazon: All Gaming GPU Deals Amazon: Up to $500 off Gaming Monitors Amazon: Desktop and gaming PCs Newegg: Up to 69% off PC hardware A few of our other dedicated Hub Pages: Best Black Friday gaming PC deals | Best Black Friday RAM deals | Best Black Friday gaming laptop deals | Best Black Friday monitor deals | Best Black Friday SSD deals | Best Black Friday PC peripherals deals | Best Black Friday motherboard deals * The listed previous prices can vary based on retailer, as many use different metrics, like 90-day rolling averages or ‘estimated value’ due to ongoing shortages and price hikes. Good morning and welcome to the beginning of our Black Friday 2026 coverage. Here you'll find round-the-clock coverage of all the latest and greatest Black Friday deals at all your favorite PC hardware retailers! It's Stephen to start you off this morning, bringing you a host of deals from the US and the UK! If you're on the hunt for an excellent SSD in the UK, there's a big old saving to be had on this Sandisk Optimus GX Pro 8100 1TB PCIe 5.0 NVMe SSD. A rebranded version of the old Western Digital SN8100, this drive scored brilliantly in our testing earlier this year. Right now, you can score one for £175.99 instead of £268.99, a 35% saving and the lowest-ever price recorded on this drive at Amazon UK. Our testing involved the 8TB version of this drive, with boasts better write speeds than the 1TB version, but you can see from our benchmark data how it stacks up to rivals in latency. If you're in the market for more capacity, this listing also includes savings on the 2TB and 4TB models, however the 1TB version boasts the biggest saving and the best value overall, in my opinion. - Stephen Warwick One of the best SSD deals we've seen in the US so far is this excellent Team Group T-Force G50 Evo. This Gen 4 M.2 2280 drive is one of the cheapest 4TB drives out there right now at $0.10 cents per GB. With AI inflating the cost of storage and RAM, this is as good as it gets for a high capacity drive these days. Save $86 on the list price bringing the cost to just $399. An entry-level drive, this PCIe 4.0 model offers sequential read speeds of up to 5,000 MB/s and sequential write speeds of up to 4,700 MB/s. It also features SLC Caching and Host Memory Buffer. While this certainly isn't the fastest drive on the market, it is more than enough for an all-around drive for storing games and files, if not for higher-octane use cases like video editing, or anything else latency-intensive. - Stephen Warwick The legendary Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU may not be the out-and-out fastest gaming CPU on the market anymore, but it is still the best thanks to its devastating gaming performance and its much lower power draw versus the 9850X3D. It just hit a new lowest-ever price at Amazon UK, now just £312.99. This is perfect for anyone on AM5 looking for an upgrade, or anyone who wants to build a storming gaming PC in the Black Friday sales. That's a lot cheaper than it was in the June sales, when we saw it at £339.99. As you can see from our testing data, this is an unbelievable CPU for gaming. It powers high frame rates thanks to its industry-leading 3D cache, which means the CPU has to fall back on your RAM much less often, drastically boosting frame rates. This is a CPU that needs no introduction and leads the pack even at its list price. At £312.99, I'm seriously considering buying one myself. - Stephen Warwick If you want a Windows alternative to the MacBook Neo at a price that won't break the bank, this Dell XPS 13 with Intel Core 5 CPU is now just $549.99. This model comes with Intel's Wildcat Lake Core 5 320 CPU, 8GB of RAM, and a 256GB SSD, matching the Neo in terms of specs. You also get a backlit keyboard, which you won't find on the MacBook, as well as a higher-resolution 2560 x 1600 touch screen. As our testing shows, the Dell can't beat the Mac for outright performance, but it does run Windows and is $100 cheaper at the current prices. If you'd rather have the Neo, the cheapest price is currently $649 at Amazon, a $50 saving on the list price, which Apple increased not long after launch. Either of these will serve you well if you want a lightweight, portable computer for basic tasks like word processing, checking your emails, and on-the-go college assignments. However, they won't cut the mustard if you're looking for something to game on, edit videos, or do anything else graphic intensive. - Stephen Warwick The Corsair Xeneon Edge is a nifty 14.5-inch 2K portable LCD touchscreen for your PC. You can use it in a number of different ways: embedded in a compatible Corsair case, mounted on your setup with magnets, or just sat on your desk as a standalone monitor. It can be used to keep an eye on your PC's vital signs, as a media control unit for apps like Spotify, or as a streaming extension for monitoring chat or as a virtual Stream Deck. Now at its lowest-ever price in the UK, it's just £174.99. You can also score it in the US for $199 instead of $249.99, a $50 saving. With its 60 Hz refresh rate and multi-touch, the Xeneon Edge is one of the most popular PC accessories going right now, and makes for a really novel and unique upgrade to your space. It also comes with 14 magnets so you can attach it at will to any metal surface. There are tons of built-in widgets available through Corsair's marketplace, including many free options such as NVA live scores or a Steam deal tracker. You can even 3D print your own accessories to customize it. - Stephen Warwick A good Wi-Fi router is a serious upgrade to your home, and Wi-Fi 7 is the current gold standard. We loved this TP-Link Archer BE770 tri-band router when we reviewed it, and now it is a massive 24% off at Amazon, down to just $280. This router boasts excellent 6 GHz performance — around 2,500 Mbps in iPerf 3 — and great 5 GHz performance of around 1,500 Mbps. It also features a 10 Gbps LAN port, as well as four 1 Gbps LAN ports. That's not many for a $400 router, but a much easier sell at this discounted price of $280. This router also comes with a HomeShield suite of security features including a network scanner to check for security risks and monitor performance. As per our router expert Brandon Hill, this is a very easy Wi-Fi 7 upgrade recommendation at just $280. - Stephen Warwick This absolutely monstrous gaming laptop ships with an RTX 5080 GPU, 18-inch Mini LED display, 1TB Gen 5 SSD, and 32GB of RAM. Under the hood, there's Intel's Arrow Lake-HX Core Ultra 9 275HX CPU. This 24-core, 24-thread mobile CPU boasts boost clock speeds of up to 5.4GHz. The spec sheet on this laptop is frankly eye-watering. The display is a massive 18-inch, 250Hz WQXGA Mini LED, a vast size for gaming and productivity. Alongside the aforementioned processor, which packs a serious punch, you get the RTX 5080 laptop GPU. The Mobile version features 16GB of GDDR7 VRAM for gaming, as well as 7,680. This will chew through games at the native resolution of 2560x1600. You also get that all-important 32GB of RAM, plus 1TB of SSD storage for your games and files. This one is an absolute knockout at Amazon UK - Stephen Warwick A solid pre-built is one of the best ways to get around massive price inflation on SSDs, RAM, and GPUs. This CyberPowerPC gaming rig at Newegg is a fantastic deal at $130 off, now just $2,099. As our CPU benchmark data shows, the 7800X3D can still stack up to the best CPUs on the market, including AMD's potent 9000-series SKUs. This is a formidable rig for gaming thanks to the 8-core AM5 CPU. That CPU is paired with an RTX 5070, a brilliant GPU for 1440p and even 4K gaming with help from Nvidia's DLSS multi-frame generation technology. With 12GB of GDDR7 VRAM, this card is the perfect pairing for the 7800X3D. Otherwise, this rig is supported by 32GB of RAM and a 1TB M.2 SSD. You also get liquid cooling to keep the CPU cool, as well as a plethora of RGB fans all packaged in a stylish case. This is one of the better gaming PCs out there at a price that won't break the bank. - Stephen Warwick If you want to upgrade your gaming PC without spending tons on a new GPU, SSD, or RAM, an OLED gaming monitor is one of the easiest (and most affordable) upgrades you can make right now. At Amazon UK, this AOC Ago Pro 27-inch OLED monitor is £60 off, just £20 off the lowest-ever price we've seen on this model. A sub-£300 27-inch OLED monitor is great value. This will power 1440p gaming at high-refresh rates, provided you have the gaming hardware to match. It also comes with two HDMI 2.1 ports (so you could also use this with an Xbox Series X or PlayStation 5), as well as DisplayPort, a USB hub, and an audio jack. - Stephen Warwick We absolutely love the Asus ROG Strix Scar 16, with its excellent display, upgrade options, and strong gaming performance. It scored four stars in our review of the 5080 version, and the 5090 model on sale here is even more powerful. Right now, Newegg has slashed $350 off the price, bringing it to $4,149.99. The headline feature of this monstrous laptop is, of course, the RTX 5090 GPU with 24GB of VRAM, which will play any game at the 2560 x 1600 resolution. Heck, you could even use it to run some local AI if you really wanted to. While we didn't test this specific configuration in our review, as you can see from our benchmark data, the RTX 5090 laptop GPU is no slouch: The CPU is Intel's Arrow Lake-HX Core Ultra 9 275HX CPU. This 24-core monster has a max boost clock of 5.4 GHz, with a base power draw of 55W. Combined, the CPU and GPU should support playing any game on the market today. The display is a 2560 x 1600 Mini-LED with a 240Hz refresh rate, a really rich display that we loved in our review. Other components include 32GB of DDR5 5600 RAM, a 2TB M.2 Gen 4 SSD, Windows 11 Pro, three USB 3.2 Gen2 (10 Gbps) Type-A ports, two Thunderbolt 5 80 Gbps ports (w/DP support), and a single 3.5mm combo audio jack. You also get 2.5 GbE Ethernet and Wi-Fi 7. A laptop of truly obscene power. - Stephen Warwick Whether you're a streamer or just looking to boost productivity, Elgato's Stream Deck adds 15 customizable LCD keys to your setup for instant, one-touch control of your favorite apps. You can use it to tune your audio, adjust lights, mute your microphone, or really anything else you can think of. The MK.2 version is normally $149, but now both the black and white models are down to $109.99 at Amazon, less than $2 shy of their lowest-ever price of $108.25. The standard MK.2 Stream Deck comes with 15 customizable LCD keys in a three-by-five configuration. The faceplate is interchangeable, and the USB-C cable is detachable, with a desktop stand for a 45-degree tilt. The buttons can be programmed for tons of functions that you might otherwise perform with your mouse and keyboard, as well as for executing macros and interactions with peripherals and devices. You can read our full review of the Stream Deck MK.2 here. — Stephen Warwick
